svg.title: Federated Learning & Privacy-Preserving ML Architecture
svg.desc: Federated Learning diagram showing edge client model training, Secure Aggregation, Differential Privacy noise injection, and Central Server global model update.
svg.text: Decentralized edge model training, Secure Aggregation (SMPC), and Differential Privacy gradient noise.
• Edge Nodes (Mobile/IoT/Hospitals): Train local model weights on private data
• Zero Raw Data Exfiltration: Raw training data never leaves local hardware boundary
• Local Differential Privacy (LDP): Injects (ε, δ) Laplacian noise into gradient updates
• Secure Aggregation (SecAgg): SMPC secret-sharing combines client gradients
• Central Server: Sees only aggregate sum of updates; cannot inspect individual client weights
• Global Model Update: Publishes updated global model weights back to edge clients
• Sybil & Model Poisoning: Malicious clients submitting corrupted gradients to derail global model accuracy
• Robust Aggregation Algorithms: Krum, Trimmed Mean, and Bounded Norm Clipping filtering outlier gradients
• Membership Inference Protection: Central DP noise prevents attackers from deducing whether a specific record was in training data
FEDERATED LEARNING: LOCAL EDGE TRAINING → LDP NOISE INJECTION → SECURE AGGREGATION → GLOBAL MODEL BROADCAST
